description: Turn text into speech with a free YangOpen voice and get a link to the MP3. It costs no credit; it counts against the user's free daily allowance. Up to 3,000 characters per call: split longer text at sentence ends and call once per part. The link works for 24 hours; give it to the user exactly as returned. The text is sent to an outside speech service to be read; it is not stored.

text.description: The text to read, up to 3,000 characters.

voice.description: A free voice id from list_voices. Default yo-baotram (Vietnamese, female).

name: text_to_speech
title: Read text aloud as an MP3 (free voices)
